name: SPOTIFY_MUSIC
description: BabiesIQ SPOTIFY_MUSIC — Telegram Music Bot with YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud & Resso support.

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID — get from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash — get from https://my.telegram.org

LOGGER_ID.description: Telegram Group/Channel ID where bot logs are sent (negative integer for group)

MONGO_DB_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI — get free cluster from https://mongodb.com/atlas

STRING_SESSION.description: Pyrogram string session for the assistant account (generate with @StringSessionBot)

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Your Heroku app name (for auto-restart feature)

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Your Heroku API key — find in Heroku Account Settings

SUPPORT_CHANNEL.description: Telegram support channel link (must start with https://)

SUPPORT_CHAT.description: Telegram support group link (must start with https://)

GIT_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (for private repo auto-updates)

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Spotify Developer App Client ID — https://developer.spotify.com

PLAYLIST_FETCH_LIMIT.description: Max songs to fetch from a playlist

AUTO_LEAVING_ASSISTANT.description: Enable auto-leave for assistant after stream ends (True/False)

AUTO_LEAVE_ASSISTANT_TIME.description: Time in seconds before assistant auto-leaves

TG_AUDIO_FILESIZE_LIMIT.description: Telegram audio file size limit in bytes

TG_VIDEO_FILESIZE_LIMIT.description: Telegram video file size limit in bytes
